sources.snippet: Transfer learning is the process of transferring learned features from one application to another. It is a commonly used training technique where you use a model trained on one task and re-train to use it on a different task. Train Adapt Optimize (TAO) Toolkit is a simple and easy-to-use Python based AI toolkit for taking purpose-built AI models and customizing them with users' own data.

sources.title: EfficientDet-D0: Compact Object Detector
sources.snippet: EfficientDet-D0 is a compact object detector that employs compound scaling to balance model size and detection accuracy. It integrates an EfficientNet-B0 backbone with a 3-layer BiFPN architecture to fuse multi-scale features using weighted sums and depthwise separable convolutions.
